title: The Warden's Debt
summary: Gorran writes from a village far from any prison. He guards their gate now, with a spear and no keys, and he has something to give you.

quest_book.title: A Gate Without a Lock
quest_book.author: Gorran
pages:
You let me walk out of the Bastille.

I found a village that needed a gate guard and didn't ask questions.

Come and see me. I've kept something for you all this time.

- Gorran

threats.name: Gorran the Gatekeeper
threats.target_line: Ha! You found me. Come in, I've been keeping something for you.
talk: No keys any more. Just a gate and a spear. I sleep at night now.
You said you had something for me.
The cult paid me in this. I never spent it. It's yours.
